model: EfficientNet-B0 fine-tuned on HAM10000 (GIBC V2 Track 02)
notes: Logits are divided by `temperature` before sigmoid to produce calibrated probabilities. TTA averages the logits of the original and horizontally flipped image. Trained via: src.train (11 epochs) then src.resume (10 epochs, lr 1e-5, cosine).
